adversarial_test_results.prompt: To go pleaded abroad remains odd.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: To market abroad costs plenty.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Market as a verb after infinitival to, not a head noun after a modifier, with no determiner-noun or subject-verb frame elsewhere.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: To often capital abroad seems odd.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Capital forced into verb slot after the adverb often, with every other bigram frame-free by token check.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Very degrees abroad seem odd.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Noun degrees after the adverb Very instead of a number; rewritten to avoid the undergraduates subword split and quantifier-noun frame.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Often numpy under desks.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Low-baseline numpy after a plain adverb with no import keyword; nonce gibberish was unusable since its subword pieces self-trigger.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Seldom add before dawn.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Add as a noun after the adverb seldom with no def keyword and no other valid frame in the string.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Again chemical before dawn.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Chemical after the adverb Again instead of a determiner, with no subject-verb or ly-split confound.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: To sing eight before dawn.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Quantity eight after the verb sing rather than a number or at least, with no subject-verb bigram.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: >< Hello abroad.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Trigger >< opens the probe with no preceding complete phrase, so the punctuation frame cannot trigger.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: To name guests before dawn.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Name as a verb after particle To with no keyword opener; rewritten to avoid the Quickly subword split and every-noun frame.
